subject: Lumen Retail trial: scope change and sprint gate plan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Oct 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Lumen Retail trial: scope change and sprint gate plan

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we’re all aligned before the trial kickoff:

Summary of what Lumen wants to validate
- Product discovery + assisted search for web catalog (primary)
- Chat-driven customer support flow for returns (secondary)
- Measure latency and token cost under 95th percentile traffic spikes (non-functional)

Proposed initial success criteria (baseline)
1) Search precision: top-3 CTR lift >= 8% vs current baseline on test prompt set (50 prompts)
2) Chat accuracy: 90% intent recognition for returns-related intents on annotated sample (200 dialogs)
3) Performance: p95 generation latency < 380ms for 512-token horizon in our dedicated environment

POC plan & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and data-sharing checklist — deliverable: SOW draft (attached)
- Week 1–2: data ingest + mapping; Redwood will run an initial embedding/index build
- Week 3: integration smoke tests (search + chat) in staging; evaluate acceptance prompts
- Week 4: production-like load test and final acceptance decision

Owners
- Redwood: Dylan (sales lead) + Ben (SE lead) + Monica (CS/ops for data)
- Lumen: Tom (prod lead) + Priya (data owner)

Open items we need from you this week
- Confirm the two focal datasets (catalog feed + returns logs) and expected sample delivery date
- Approve the attached SOW draft or send edits by Tue, Oct 7

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-draft.pdf (PDF, 48 KB), lumen-data-mapping-template.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)

If that timetable looks reasonable I’ll get the SOW updated and loop legal for a quick 1-week signature path.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2025 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumen Retail trial: scope change and sprint gate plan

Thanks, Dylan — good write-up. A couple of changes from our side after talking to the catalog team:

1) Add a POS-to-search reconciliation use case — we want to validate that search results correlate with in-store sell-through for promotional SKUs. That’s a higher-priority secondary use case for us.
2) We’ll need an extra week for the data mapping step because POS extracts require vendor approval.

Can you show how the success criteria change if we confirm the POS use case? Also confirm whether the extra week pushes back the final acceptance by more than two weeks.

We’ll aim to get the sample catalog + a masked POS extract to you by Oct 13.

—Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Product, Lumen Retail
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenretail.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumen Retail trial: scope change and sprint gate plan

On Sun, 05 Oct 2025 at 09:28, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Dylan — good write-up. A couple of changes from our side after talking to the catalog team:
>
> 1) Add a POS-to-search reconciliation use case — we want to validate that search results correlate with in-store sell-through for promotional SKUs. That’s a higher-priority secondary use case for us.
> 2) We’ll need an extra week for the data mapping step because POS extracts require vendor approval.

Good questions — short answers and an updated plan below.

Effect on acceptance criteria if POS reconciliation is added
- We’ll add a new metric: promotion lift correlation (Pearson r) between search click-through for promoted SKUs and store-level sell-through during a 4-week window. Target: r >= 0.45 on the test batch.
- Performance SLAs remain the same for generation latency.
- For search precision, we’ll split the prompt set into catalog-native prompts vs promo SKUs and report both metrics.

Updated timeline (reflects +1 week for data mapping)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and sign — deliverable: SOW signed
- Week 1–3: data ingest + mapping (includes POS vendor approvals)
- Week 4: embedding/index build + internal QA
- Week 5: integration smoke tests for web search and POS reconciliation scripts in staging
- Week 6: production-like load test, acceptance reporting, handoff

Owners (clarified)
- Redwood SE (Ben): implementation plan & evaluation script for metric calculations
- Redwood Ops (Monica): data ingestion, transformation, and secure transfer setup
- Redwood Sales (Dylan): commercial/contract coordination
- Lumen (Tom): final dataset approvals; (Priya): data delivery point-of-contact

Acceptance checkpoints (sprint gates)
- Gate 1 (end Week 3): data ingestion complete + smoke index build — pass/fail by Lumen data owner
- Gate 2 (end Week 5): integrated correctness tests for POS reconciliation scripts and search relevance — pass/fail using pre-agreed prompt set
- Gate 3 (end Week 6): load test & acceptance metrics reported; go/no-go decision

We updated the SOW to reflect the POS use case and added a data mapping template in the drive. I attached the revised SOW here and included the formula we'll use for the promotion lift correlation. Please review and let us know if you need the correlation script or sample notebook before Week 3.

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-draft.pdf (revised), lumen-data-mapping-template.xlsx

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@lumenretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumen Retail trial: scope change and sprint gate plan

Ben — thanks for the clarity and the revised timeline. That updated gate structure makes sense and the promotion lift metric is what our analytics team wanted to see.

We approve the revised SOW in principle. Next steps from our side:
- Priya will push the masked POS extract to the shared Drive folder by Oct 13 as noted.
- Please send the final SOW to our procurement team and include the HubSpot/DocuSign link for signature. We prefer a 7-day turnaround on the signature to keep Week 0 constrained.

If you can get the DocuSign link and the final SOW by Mon, Oct 13 I’ll route to procurement the same day.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Product, Lumen Retail
